title: unfc
summary: A student coursework repository for a Master's program in Data Analytics, containing Jupyter notebooks for course assignments on topics like synthetic data generation and credit-risk analysis. Several notebooks import sdv.single_table synthesizers (GaussianCopula, CTGAN, CopulaGAN, TVAE) and sdv.evaluation.single_table utilities, and one notebook also imports the standalone copulas package directly, to fit and sample synthetic tabular data and evaluate its quality.
evidence: t4-ada-assignment-1-challenge-1_updated_v2.ipynb: 'from sdv.single_table import GaussianCopulaSynthesizer, CTGANSynthesizer' with fit/sample calls
needs: Repo is a student coursework project with no named authors; industry mix (german credit vs generic exercises) makes domain assignment approximate.
